entity.name: Glassbox Project Team
entity.description: The team stewarding Glassbox, an independent open-source Solana transparency and accountability toolkit.

projects.name: Glassbox
projects.description: An open-source Solana transparency and accountability toolkit for wallet inspection, transaction verification, funding transparency, downloadable reports, and auditable project records. Seeking $15,000 in non-dilutive public-good grant support for development, security review, infrastructure, Solana integration, documentation, community testing, and contingency. Glassbox has no token.

channels.description: Contact the project team to discuss grants and secure funding arrangements.

plans.name: Glassbox public-goods grant
plans.description: A $15,000 non-dilutive public-good grant request to support Glassbox development and delivery: $6,000 for software development; $2,500 for security review and testing; $1,500 for infrastructure and hosting; $2,000 for Solana integration and reliability testing; $1,000 for documentation and developer resources; $1,000 for community testing and feedback; and $1,000 contingency.
